title: Excess and decoding value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with label set $ br^q$ in the sense of labels indexed by $	ext{Fin}(q)$, and let a tester family satisfy the dictator-versus-no-notables conditions with parameters $4alpha$ and $4beta$ and error function $4error$. If $q>0$, $T$ is a table of functions on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$, $0<4epsilon\le 1$, and $\alpha+\operatorname{error}(\epsilon)+\tau$ is at most the tester’s averaged acceptance value on $T$, then $\tau\epsilon^5/18$ is at most the decoding value of $T$ at threshold $\epsilon$, using label $0$ as the default.
hypotheses_covered: Tester family satisfies all dictator-versus-no-notables conditions
A bounded table of cube functions
Tester averaged acceptance is at least $\alpha+\operatorname{error}(\epsilon)+\tau$
caveat: The first hypothesis is a bundled structure with several conditions; the statement summarizes it rather than spelling out every field.
